claims.text: Many reviewers say it makes lashes look longer, fuller, and more natural.
Several reviewers complain that fibers or material fall off into their eyes and make a mess.
Some reviewers find the application clumpy or messy and not smooth.
A few reviewers note the packaging/instructions are in Chinese or another language with no clear instructions.
Some reviewers say it is easy to use and works well for the price.
